description: Acquire an authorized RGBD capture. Associate only task-involved objects. For each known task identity, Decisions selects a current mask using confirmed dated reference images, then links that subject across other cameras. Enforce mask ownership and bidirectional calibrated geometry conflicts through all already-confirmed same-object views. Include those labelled views and established correspondences in the current Decisions request. Exclude masks already selected for other subjects from subsequent choices while keeping their ownership visible. Match container and content contours separately and include only labelled identity reference views. Inherit the confirmed permanent ID. Older confirmed references support recovery when recent evidence is insufficient. Discover and register additional matching task inputs for all/count tasks. Other visible objects supply visual context. Collision geometry covers task instances and required supports. Completed container contents with valid entry and occupied-range receipts defer individual reassociation. Preserve original identity masks and commit accepted observations transactionally. CAD 模型绑定采用 resources/cad_subject_policy.json 中的用户场景声明。已确认身份的 black/object 绑定黑色工件 CAD，blue/bin 绑定蓝盒 CAD，其余身份使用 TSDF。程序按该声明绑定模型并保留来源，FoundationPose 使用当前 SAM3 掩码和 RGBD 估计位姿。 Subject ownership proposals are tentative until cross-camera and competing-owner checks finish. Joint conflict adjudication allows at most one loser reselection; unresolved conflicts never commit. Dated archive fallback selects at most three confirmed captures per permanent ID.
capability: Acquire or reuse an authorized RGBD capture
